issues.description: React hydration mismatch errors occurring multiple times on the auth page. Server-rendered HTML text content does not match client-rendered content, causing the entire root to switch to client rendering.
issues.root_cause: A component on the auth page is rendering different content on server vs client. Common causes: using Date(), Math.random(), window/localStorage, or browser-only APIs during render without proper guards (e.g., missing 'use client' directive or accessing browser APIs during SSR). The repeated hydration errors suggest something like a timestamp, random ID, or browser-environment check that differs between server and client render.

fixes.reason: Ensure 'use client' is present and hooks are imported to allow safe client-only rendering patterns
